summary: Completed regression testing after major frontend/backend structural refactor. All 13 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI tests passed - homepage loads correctly, translation flow works (English↔Spanish), premium modal opens from crown button, conversation mode premium gating works correctly, swap languages button works, all core UI elements render properly.

POST /api/translate - English to Spanish translation works
POST /api/translate - Spanish to English translation works
POST /api/translate - empty text returns empty translation
POST /api/translate - whitespace-only text returns empty translation
POST /api/text-to-speech - English TTS returns audio
POST /api/text-to-speech - Spanish TTS returns audio
POST /api/text-to-speech - empty text returns 400
POST /api/speech-to-text - requires audio file (422)
POST /api/speech-to-text - small audio returns error
POST /api/payments/check-premium - unknown email returns is_premium=false
POST /api/payments/check-premium - missing email returns 422
GET /api/history - returns translation history list
UI: Homepage loads with all core components
UI: Source/Target panes render correctly
UI: Swap languages button works
UI: Translation flow works (Good morning → Buenos días)
UI: Premium modal opens from crown button
UI: Premium modal has email input, checkout, restore buttons
UI: Conversation mode premium gating works (toast shown for free users)
UI: Free tier banner visible at bottom
UI: Status indicator shows Ready state
critical_code_review_comments: ESLint warning in useConversationManager.js line 429-430: refs used in cleanup function - this is a common pattern and works correctly, but could be refactored to copy ref.current to a local variable for stricter compliance
App.js successfully refactored from ~1440 lines to ~170 lines - excellent modularization into hooks and components
Backend services properly separated into translation_service.py, speech_service.py, conversation_service.py, payment_service.py, history_service.py
test_credentials: No auth credentials required for this app
seed_data_creation: None - tests use live translation API
context_for_next_testing_agent: Major structural refactor completed successfully. Backend split into services (translation_service, speech_service, conversation_service, payment_service, history_service). All endpoints working: /api/translate, /api/text-to-speech, /api/speech-to-text, /api/payments/check-premium, /api/history. Premium gating for conversation mode working correctly.
